Bill.BriefDescription: Clarifying that boarding homes are not subject to taxation under chapter 82.04 RCW.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the tax treatment of boarding homes; andcreating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature makes the followingclarification: Boarding homes licensed under chapter 18.20 RCW areengaged in the renting or leasing of real property to consumers and,accordingly, are exempt from taxation under chapter 82.04 RCW.
